Here With YouThe problem

Emma's recovery between appointments

Joint pain, fatigue and worry affect the same day.

She wants to remember difficult days before her next oncology appointment, and keep today's plans manageable.

Meet Emma

A fictional composite from our research

Active hospital treatment has ended. She is eighteen months into prescribed hormone therapy.

"I'd like enough energy to call my sister at three."

Synthetic scenario dialogue. This is not patient testimony.

Here With YouThe product

A journal shaped by Emma's context

Designed to turn her spoken account into an editable Journal entry and a small day plan.

Voice saving awaits a genuine spoken save and readback04 / 06

Open the public app and briefly show all three context pages. Use the following exact request only after the coordinated microphone gate is ready.

"I'm Emma. Since breast cancer treatment ended, the fatigue hasn't gone away. Today it's six out of ten, my hand pain is seven, and I slept five hours. I'm worried about my next oncology appointment. I took my prescribed letrozole, 2.5 milligrams, at nine this morning. I'd like enough energy to call my sister at three. Please save this in my journal and make a manageable plan using my pages."

Check one new entry for fatigue 6/10, hand pain 7/10, five hours' sleep, worry about follow-up and the reported letrozole 2.5 mg at 09:00. This is a fictional existing prescription, not a dose recommendation or an inference about the cause of symptoms. Check a Day plan traceable to her preferences, with one or two priorities. Reload the same entry.

Only say "saved" after the canonical stored result confirms it. If saving fails or remains unvalidated, show the actual pages/manual editing and say voice saving remains unproven. Do not insert a pretend voice entry. A fallback recording must show a previously validated run and be labelled as a recording.

Keep any Atech beat within the owner's verified behavior. Hardware speech to Journal is unverified. Stop retires backend writing separately from provider finalization. Already committed entries survive Stop.
